reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two separate findings—that randomizing Cr coating grain orientation improves oxidation resistance (P13) and that HCPEB refines Zircaloy-4 microstructure (P40)—into a new proposal to apply HCPEB post-treatment to Cr-coated cladding, a combination not suggested in any passage. It also links them through a stated mechanism (reducing oxygen diffusion paths) and proposes a falsification test that integrates oxidation and irradiation performance.
copied_elements: columnar grain boundaries as oxygen diffusion paths (P13)
random grain orientation improves oxidation resistance (P13)
HCPEB refines microstructure and improves corrosion resistance (P40)
